grade.first_issue: No decisive defect. The comparison argument on the range, followed by connectedness, correctly proves that the nonnegative defect g(x)=f(x)-x is constant.
grade.summary: The submission correctly identifies all solutions as f(x)=x+c with c≥0, verifies the converse, and proves necessity. It derives orbit invariance and nonnegativity of g, establishes injectivity, shows all positive values of g coincide via an asymptotic range estimate, and excludes coexistence of defect values 0 and c using openness and connectedness.
strengths: Correctly obtains f(f(y))=2f(y)-y and hence g(f(x))=g(x).
Correctly derives f^(n)(x)=x+ng(x) and uses positivity to show g(x)≥0.
The range estimate is valid and implies that all positive defect values are equal.
The openness arguments for D_0 and D_c correctly rule out mixed defect levels.
Both inequalities are correctly verified for f(x)=x+c.
